walkthrough: Goal: tell at a glance, in every bar, panel and dialog, which word is the chosen one and which words are commands, the same way the icons tell it: the ink ring means chosen.

Entry: on an empty library (2880 x 1800, landscape) draw a closed triangle with the pen. The left island reads Gallery as a bare word in ink beside the Actions, Selection and Transform icons: no box inside the island's outline.

Choice: tap Selection (the lasso takes its ink ring). The bar in the top band's middle reads Freehand, Rectangle, a thin faint upright line, then Invert and Deselect (grey: nothing selected). Freehand carries an ink pill, the icon ring's line drawn round the word; nothing else has a frame. Tap Rectangle: the pill fades from Freehand and draws in round Rectangle where it is (acknowledge), no new frame appears.

Commands: drag a rectangle with the pen: Deselect turns from grey to ink. Drop the colour outside the rectangle: a notice says Drop inside the selection to fill, a thin line, OK as a bare word; tap OK. Tap Deselect (the press wash shows under the hand): the selection goes, Deselect greys. Tap Selection to put the tool away.
Fill: drop the colour inside the triangle: it fills, and the fill bar offers Continue filling as a bare word; tap it: Tap an area to fill it, Done; tap Done.

Transform: tap Transform: the bar reads Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical, Rotate 45° and Reset (grey: nothing moved), bare words in ink. Tap Rotate 45°: Reset turns ink; tap Reset, then Transform to put it away (nothing recorded).

Layer options: tap Layers: under Opacity the four modes in two columns, Normal carrying the ink pill, Multiply, Screen and Overlay bare. Tap Multiply: the pill moves there as the icon rings do. Tap Normal again. Group in the footer's row is a bare word (grey: nothing to group with). Tap Mask: the footer reads Black hides · white shows in quieter grey, then Invert and Clear as bare ink words and the bin.

Dialogs: tap the canvas to close the panel, then Gallery. Tap the card's title: Rename with its field, Cancel and Done as bare words at the right; Cancel. Tap the card's bin: Delete “Untitled Artwork”? This can't be undone, then Cancel and Delete as bare ink words at the right; Cancel: nothing changes.

Hit targets stay 48 points high and at least 48 wide; unavailable words are pencil grey; nothing the hand taps is a frame inside a frame. Not here: any change to what a control does or to the artwork.
